description: Amazon's Selling Partner API lets sellers and developers integrate with Amazon selling programmatically.
auth_notes: Applications are registered in the Solution Provider Portal with roles; private apps self-authorize in draft status. Outbound credential type is not stated in the sources.
gate_detail: Requires a Professional Selling Account, a Solution Provider Portal account, and a data access request qualifying for specific roles after policy and security review. Private apps self-authorize; sandbox endpoints exist.
api_scope: Endpoints grouped under roles; use cases include inventory automation, product research, feedback management and keyword optimization for Amazon stores. API style is not stated in the sources.
mcp_notes: The MCP sources cover AWS Partner Central, a different product, so nothing is established for SP-API.
blocker_detail: Developers must request data access and qualify for roles; only Professional Selling Accounts are eligible.

evidence.quote: Only Professional Selling Accounts can register to develop or integrate with Selling Partner API. Individual accounts are not eligible.
you must request and qualify for a particular role to access the operations and resources grouped under that role.
You can self-authorize your application in draft status; there is no need to publish a private application.
we recommend using Postman and making a call to one of our sandbox endpoints.
Amazon Sellers can use SP-API to set up private integrations and build solutions exclusively for their Amazon store

uncertainties: Outbound authentication mechanism is not stated in the sources.
API style and webhook or notification support are not stated.
Sources S3 to S5 describe AWS Partner Central, not SP-API, and were not used.
